client_presets.note: sprint canon; repo host preset is 390×844 — design decision C11

behaviour.layout: Project laid out at the preset's true logical pixels (its own breakpoints apply), then scaled to fit the client's screen — same mechanism as DESIGN/VIEWPORT.
behaviour.on_phone: Default MOBILE fills the screen (no frame chrome); TABLET/DESKTOP shown scaled with a "SCALED PREVIEW" label and OPEN FULL PREVIEW.
behaviour.on_desktop: Device frame centred on a quiet off-white stage; controls in a single top strip.
behaviour.orientation: Portrait only for client review (landscape internal).

reuse: Wrap viewportTargets.ts + DesignChamber VIEWPORT stage in a ClientViewport component that exposes only client controls (host stays in charge of the frame).
